name: Titanium.Media.AudioRecorder
summary: An audio recorder object used for recording audio from the device microphone.
description:
Use the [Titanium.Media.createAudioRecorder](api:Titanium.Media#createAudioRecorder) method to create an audio recorder.

Ensure to request the permissions for audio-recording before starting a new record-session.
This can be done by using [Titanium.Media.hasAudioRecorderPermissions](api:Titanium.Media#hasAudioRecorderPermissions) to check whether
audio-permissions are granted and [Titanium.Media.requestAudioRecorderPermissions](api:Titanium.Media#requestAudioRecorderPermissions) to 
request audio-permissions. 

**Android Platform Note**: On Android, you also need to include the following permission
into the `<android>` section of the tiapp.xml:

``` xml
<android xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <manifest>
        <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    </manifest>
</android>
```
